about: Frozen language test, written on 2026-10-06 before the language-aware router (router v2) and the translation of Telugu typed in English letters were run. Each question has its domain, its language ('telugu' covers Telugu script AND Telugu in English letters), and -- where the answering text is known -- probes, matched as in retrieval_eval.py. Groups: english, telugu_script, telugu_roman. The Telugu-script and romanized questions with probes ask the same things, so the two alphabets can be compared. Scored by eval/language_eval.py.
